resources.string: Messages are not marked as read, you always appear offline and your typing is not shown. Unread counters may reappear after the app syncs.
Hides your own phone number everywhere in the app, handy for screen recording and streams.
If the other person deletes a message for everyone, it stays in your chat. Works for messages that arrive while the app is signed in.
One command per line, like /hi = Hello! When you send exactly /hi, it is replaced by the text.
A second passcode. When someone enters it instead of the real one, the app quietly signs out of all accounts on this device. Use a different code from your real passcode.
Set a passcode first (Privacy and Security → Passcode Lock)
The decoy passcode must differ from the real one
Locks the app as soon as you leave it. Needs a passcode.
Type a command instead of a message: .id shows chat and message ids, .mute and .unmute control notifications. In reply to a message: .pin, .unpin, and .del (your own message).
Hide messages of blocked people in groups
Possible scam. Do not send money or open links.
Show ID and registration date in profiles
Blur the screen during round videos
While a round video plays, the rest of the chat is blurred. Scrolling or pausing removes the blur. Needs Android 12 or newer.
